criteria.reason: The ledger has an exact closed top-level shape, an exact typed state for T0, T1-T8, and G0-G2, exactly one current invocation reference, and exact constants for every other string, list, and object. The seeded and independently inspected contradictory progress variants are rejected.

The valid full epoch-1 fixture passes, and the checker now binds raw transition digest and filename, active candidate epoch/ref/digest, candidate descriptor bytes, and epoch-0b prior while rejecting the exact fabricated-pointer shape. However it does not validate the transition against proof-contract-transition.v1: malformed or contradictory records missing required qualification/validator/activation fields, containing forbidden extra fields, escaping through qualification references, or using boolean epochs are accepted. Such an artifact is not a valid active transition, so the binding is not complete.
All nine files in the three prior rejected verdict/subject/report trios match their frozen exact-byte hashes and are absent from the candidate diff.

findings.summary: The advanced-epoch checker accepts digest-linked transition JSON that violates proof-contract-transition.v1, including missing qualification verdict, validator identity, and activation time; forbidden extra properties; escaping qualification refs; and boolean epoch values.
